name: Roland RD-700
description: Roland RD-700 digital stage piano (2001): the system blocks and the temporary Setup — common, MFX, chorus, reverb, the Local and MIDI Tx Part of each keyboard zone, the sixteen Internal Parts with their tone settings, and the ten tone-wheel organ settings — from the MIDI Implementation chapter of the owner's manual.

sources.title: RD-700 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Mar. 1, 2001)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from RD-700_OM.pdf (sha256 6778200c4b840098e5ad3c62ead339ba3a619021a691a1f0c847fe0bc681bb0c). Model ID 00 43, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The map's cover metadata is empty (model, date, version null): the address map was read from the whole owner's manual. The MIDI Implementation chapter prints Model RD-700, Date Mar. 1, 2001, Version 1.00 at its head (p146) and on its chart (p162).

The Setup offset table (p153) prints two-byte offsets (00 00 - 69 00) under Setup (Temporary) 10 00 00 00: Setup Common is 10 00 00 00, Setup Internal Part (Part: 01) 10 00 20 00, Setup Tone Wheel 10 Backup 10 00 69 00 — as p160 <Example2> confirms.
Setup Tone Wheel 1-10 Backup (60 00 - 69 00, the "Setup VK Tone Backup" table) are ten organ settings that belong to the setup, not to a part; the manual does not say which ten tones they serve.

The map also holds tables after the address map — the Bulk Dump parameters (Setup 001-100), the GS map's System, Common, Part and Drum Setup Parameter tables, and a decimal/hex table read as rows — none of which is this model ID's edit buffer.

Setup Common prints <Reserved> at 00 50, 00 52, 00 55-00 57, 00 66-00 67 (p154); Setup Common MFX at 00 01-00 03; Setup MIDI Tx Part at 00 1A-00 1B (p156); System Common at 00 11 (p153). None is laid out.

Printed names kept as printed: "Control Assgin" (Setup Common 00 3F), "Harmonic Bar 5-1/3" without its foot mark (Setup VK Tone Backup 00 03). Harmonic Bar Assign's footage list (Setup Common 00 6B-00 72) prints "16,5-1/3',8',4',2-2/3',|'" with stray table rules and "16" and "1-3/5" without their foot marks; the labels are kept as the interpreter reads them. Its last row, UPPER1:OFF (00 72), prints the first line of the list only, so it stays a number 1 - 9.
Chorus Type (0 - 2) and Reverb Type (0 - 4) print no labels (p155); p160 names Chorus Type 02 DELAY.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the controllers, pedals and the Control Source transmit as CC (Data Transmission, p151-152) is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.memories: not laid out: the Bulk Dump parameters' Setup 001-100 (10 01 00 00 - 10 64 00 00, 00 00 05 6C each, p157), which are memory rather than edit buffer, and the SETUP Write command (F0 41 dev 00 43 12 7F 7F 7E ss nn sum F7, p157) that stores them
coverage.gs: not laid out: the GS address map (model ID 42H, pp157-158: System, Common, Part and Drum Setup parameters at 40 xx xx and 41 xx xx), which a GS DT1 reaches only while GM mode is on (p151); it is a second model ID, not this one
